stage1.impression: A dark, warm, competently built bar render with a believable plan: fir beams, record wall with speaker niches, curved timber counter, banquette with orb lamps. It still reads as CG. The floor carries big, blotchy stain maps, the ceiling throws god-rays with no source, the grade is heavily orange, and the foreground tub chair is a soft orange blur. The hero globe reads as thin neon hoops in RGB primaries with no visible disc bodies, closer to a nightclub or toy gyroscope than 25 mm cast acrylic, and its stained-glass wall projection is the brightest thing on the left. A magazine would see a generic moody bar render with a neon sculpture, not yet a specific place.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must read as six thick, polished cast-acrylic discs (visible tinted faces, slots and 25 mm edges), not as thin glowing neon hoops; globe region [275,150,445,325] lum_median >= 45 with rims not dominating
The coloured projection on the wall [170,230,240,425] must sit below the globe in brightness (median 70-105, now 136) so the object, not its shadow, is the hero
The concrete floor must read as polished board-formed/troweled concrete at real scale, without the oversized blotch map seen in [400,520,700,800]
No sourceless volumetric shafts at the ceiling [440,120,580,210] and [860,60,970,180]

The Tropos in the back-bar niches must read as tinted acrylic cabinets with white batts, not black slabs (right niche [1025,180,1085,450] median 31, need >= 45), with no clipped niche strips (clip 2.27% at [885,250,940,270])
The grade must keep the room's surfaces neutral-warm rather than orange (top band [0,0,1200,60] r/g/b medians 49/19/5)
The shopfront must show a street beyond the glass, not a flat pale panel [720,305,820,410]
A sharp, legible foreground or a cleaner foreground edge (tub chair [0,690,430,800] is a soft, 21% crushed blur)

defects.what: Globe reads as thin neon tubes in saturated primaries; disc faces and thickness invisible; reads as nightclub/toy rather than premium cast acrylic
Coloured wall projection is a hard-edged stained-glass ellipse, median 136, brighter than the globe itself (38)
Floor stain texture is oversized and blotchy, reads as a procedural noise map, not concrete
Volumetric light shaft from the ceiling with no visible source
Second sourceless haze shaft near the record wall
Tropos in the right niche reads as a dark tilted slab; tint and batts illegible
Dome pendants read as milky white bowls with clipping (0.38%) rather than smoked acrylic
Shopfront reads as a flat pale panel with no street depth
Ceiling and beams pushed orange (b_median 5); grade not neutral-warm
Foreground tub chair soft, orange, 21% crushed; reads as a blurred blob across the bottom-left
Small bright fragment at the left frame edge (p95 201), a cut-off object
Far bar stools repeat the same model in a line, read as copies

changes.problem: The globe's rim glow makes the discs read as neon hoops, and the 24 deg hard spot only lights a band through its middle, so the disc faces, slots and acrylic thickness never read.

evidence.measured: lum_median 38.0, p95 114; at 3x crop only the rims are visible, faces near-transparent

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow / hard spot cone / hard spot power
change.to: rim glow 0.007, cone 40 deg (covers the full 1.25 m sphere from 1.8 m), 260 W

changes.expected: Whole globe lit by one hard source: tinted disc faces catch light and transmit colour, polished edges glow from light piped in rather than self-emission, so it reads as thick cast acrylic; globe median rises into the mid-40s to 50s.

changes.problem: The coloured projection on the concrete is the brightest, most saturated element on the left and competes with the globe.

change.setting: Mother EARF hard spot cone (with c1)
change.to: 40 deg (the wider cone spreads the power over about 2.9 times the area; with 260 W the projection drops about 50% in linear light, larger and softer)

changes.expected: The wall shadow becomes a larger, softer coloured wash, secondary to the object, median around 80-100.

changes.problem: The floor's stain map is oversized and high in contrast, the clearest 'render' tell at 1:1.

evidence.measured: lum_range 64.6; large dark cloud blotches about 150-300 px across in the floor crop

change.from: current stain map at its scale and contrast, matte
change.to: stain scale reduced to 1/4 (mottling at 5-15 cm), stain contrast reduced about 60%, add fine aggregate and saw-cut joints; polish to roughness about 0.25 so the pendants and orbs lay soft streaked reflections

changes.expected: Floor reads as polished troweled concrete with small-scale mottling and soft practical reflections; a flatter local range.

changes.problem: Haze renders as distinct shafts from the ceiling spots with no visible source, which reads as a CG volumetric effect.

evidence.measured: lum_range 73.1 with a diagonal streak, r/g/b medians 61/27/9; a similar streak at [440,120,580,210]

changes.expected: Only a faint atmosphere around the practicals; no discrete beams on the beams/ceiling.

changes.problem: The smoked Tropos in the back-bar niches read as black slabs while the niche strips clip, so the speakers on show are not legible.

change.setting: the lit niche's strip / the record wall spots
change.from: strip 6.0; record wall 4 x spot 6.0 W
change.to: strip 3.0; record wall 4 x spot 10 W, with the two nearest the niches aimed to graze the cabinets

changes.expected: Light passes into the smoked acrylic so the white batts and horn show through the tint; no clipped strip.

changes.problem: The grade pushes the fir ceiling and concrete to saturated orange, so the room is not neutral-warm and the speakers' colour has no quiet ground.

change.to: 2650 (sources at 2400-2700 K render as warm white, not orange)

changes.expected: Beams read as brown Douglas fir and the concrete as warm grey; blue channel in the ceiling rises.

changes.problem: The shopfront is a flat pale panel with no street, so the room has no depth and no context in the city.

evidence.measured: lum_median 109.5, smooth grey with no structure beyond the glass

change.to: 2 street lamps beyond the glass, 2200 K, at the curb, about 40 W each, with the outside fill lowered so the street sits dimmer than the bar top

changes.expected: The glass shows a dark street with two warm points and a faint reflection of the room, not a lightbox.

changes.problem: The foreground tub chair is a soft orange blur cutting across the bottom-left, and a fragment pokes in at the left edge.

evidence.measured: crush_pct 21.3, edge width 26 px (soft); a bright fragment at [0,690,30,730] p95 201

change.to: f/8 focused at [9.0, 3.0, 1.0], and yaw the target about 0.1 m toward +y so the left-edge fragment leaves the frame

changes.expected: The foreground chair's leather and stitching read as a real chair at arm's length, framing the room instead of smearing it.

out_of_scope.request: Make the globe's rims less primary-saturated or the discs thicker on screen
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF's tints and 25 mm discs are fixed by the owner; only its light can change (c1).

out_of_scope.request: Dome pendants read milky white rather than smoked
out_of_scope.why: The Dome's tint and frosted liner are a fixed EARF product; the liner glow (0.05) could drop, but its look is the product's.

out_of_scope.request: Far bar stools repeat one model in a line
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed by the room's design; varied wear or a coat or bag on one (props) would help.

out_of_scope.request: Whether a magazine would publish this as a specific place
out_of_scope.why: Not yet: it reads as a generic dark bar. Its specificity rests on the globe and the speaker niches, and both are currently illegible. Fixing c1 and c5 is what would make it Planet EARF.
